support.title: Support Assistant
support.subtitle: Answers, troubleshooting & compliance help
support.greeting: Hi! I’m the Ledgr Support Assistant. I can help with how features work, troubleshoot errors you’re seeing, and answer compliance questions about your data. Pick a topic below to get started.

suggest.invoicing: How do I create and send an invoice?
suggest.expenses: How do I record an expense?
suggest.reports: How do I generate financial statements?
suggest.gettingStarted: How do I set up my business?
suggest.crash: The app crashed or shows a blank screen
suggest.login: I can’t sign in or have an MFA issue
suggest.slow: The app is slow or unresponsive
suggest.export: How do I export all my data?
suggest.delete: How do I delete my account?
suggest.gdpr: What are my data privacy rights?

support.attachDiagnostics: Attach recent app errors to help diagnose the issue
support.error: Sorry, I couldn’t reach the support assistant. Please check your connection and try again, or email support@ledgr.app.
support.escalateFooter: Still stuck? Email our team at {{email}} and we’ll pick it up — a screenshot helps.
support.placeholder: Ask a question, describe an issue, or ask about compliance…
support.enterHint: Press Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

quick.exportDesc: Download a copy of your business data (data portability).
quick.deleteDesc: Request permanent deletion — there’s a grace period to cancel.
quick.auditDesc: Review who changed what, with timestamps.
quick.termsDesc: Read the current terms you accepted.

support.contactBody: The assistant handles most questions. For billing disputes, legal, or urgent issues, email our team.
support.disclaimer: The assistant uses AI and may make mistakes. Verify important financial or compliance details. Conversations are not used to train models without your consent.

demo.bannerLabel: Demo account — sample data, not your books
demo.bannerNote: Saved in this browser only · resets in {{timeLeft}}
demo.resetDoneBody: The sample books are back to their starting point.
demo.tourCtaHint: Opens the full app with sample books — no sign-up, no password.
demo.enteringHint: Signing you in as demo@ledgr.test — no password, no sign-up. Everything you do stays in this browser.
demo.entryFailedBody: The demo runs entirely in your browser, so it needs local storage enabled. Try again in a normal (not private) window, or take the static product tour instead.

billing.title: Billing is not part of the demo
billing.body: There is nothing to pay for here — the demo account runs on sample books stored in your browser. Create a free account and pick a plan when you are ready to keep your own books.

deleteAccount.title: No account to delete
deleteAccount.body: demo@ledgr.test is a sandbox that lives in this browser only. Leaving the demo or resetting the data removes everything it created.

invites.title: Team invites are disabled in the demo
invites.body: Inviting a colleague sends a real email and creates a real user, so it is switched off here. Create a free account to invite your team.

apiKeys.title: API keys are disabled in the demo
apiKeys.body: Keys authenticate against a live Ledgr tenant. Create a free account to generate one for your own business.

webhooks.title: Webhooks are disabled in the demo
webhooks.body: Webhooks post events from a live tenant to your endpoint. Create a free account to configure them.

password.title: The demo account has no password
password.body: You are signed in as demo@ledgr.test without credentials, so there is nothing to change. Create your own account to set a password.

generic.title: Not available in the demo
generic.body: This feature acts on a live Ledgr account. Create a free account to use it with your own books.
